title: Sources Sought for Consolidation of Herbicide Contracts for Trinity Region, Texas
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.US ARMY CORPS OF ENGINEERS.ENGINEER DIVISION SOUTHWESTERN.ENDIST FT WORTH.W076 ENDIST FT WORTH
detail_text: This is a Sources Sought for the Government to make a determination of whether small businesses can support a consolidation of the herbicide and pesticide contracts for all USACE lakes within the Trinity Region of Texas. Please see attached the sources sought document and draft performance of work statements (PWS) for further details on this Sources Sought.
